desc:
🎮 Play on Xbox and PlayStation with a controller!

👍 Like the game to support more updates!

Last Water Station Tycoon

🌊 Dirty water covers the world.  
Clean water is hard to find.

People travel by boat, looking for a safe place.  
You run the last water station.  
Give them a reason to hope.

🏗️ Start your first water filter.  
Build new machines to turn dirty water into clean water.

🚤 Help the people who reach your dock.  
Earn money, grow your base, and bring the world back to life.

💧 The next boat is coming.  
Do you have enough clean water?
